description: The chart consists of three pie charts representing the distribution of problem difficulty levels categorized as easy, medium, and hard. The easy category has three slices with the following proportions: 55.4% for N+K+, 38.3% for N-K+, and 1.7% for N+K-. The medium category also has three slices with proportions of 58.8% for N+K+, 35.4% for N-K+, and 1.8% for N+K-. The hard category is divided into four slices with proportions of 37.3% for N+K+, 18.1% for N-K+, 37.9% for N+K-, and 6.7% for N-K-. Each pie chart includes a legend with color coding for the categories: N+K+ (green), N-K+ (yellow), N+K- (orange), and N-K- (red). The percentages are displayed inside the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and there is no indication of the order of the slices.
